label: D2 arrival in S1 late in the episode, after an unrewarded trial or a switch
explanation: Fires only at D2 steps whose shown state is S1 (100% of mass; never at D1/GO, never in S2) and only late in the episode (ep_trial >= ~60, peaking at 80-89; zero before trial 50), so part of it is a clock/position signal. Within S1-at-D2 late steps it prefers trials where the agent is uncertain or re-evaluating: the previous trial was unrewarded or the agent just switched its choice (stay is known at D2), low-to-mid value (value < 7.1 holds ~94% of mass) and policy logit near 0. Its strongest activations (~0.96-1.0) are common a1->S1 transitions right after an unrewarded or rare-rewarded trial, in which the agent switched to a1. It is mostly silent on S1 arrivals that continue a long rewarded S1 streak with high value. The bare (D2 & S1 & ep_trial>=70) predicate gets recall 0.98 but precision 0.14. Adding (prev_reward==0 | switch) brings F1 to 0.42 (mass recall 0.79), and narrowing to ep_trial 75-94 gives F1 0.47. Every variable in the predicate is observed at D2 (no future variables). Precision stays low, so the description is incomplete.
